entries.what: Walked to Flats High and sat through AP Calc and APUSH, then did homework at the library homework center after school.
Dishes and dinner at home; Ramón was on shift so she checked that Lola Cora took her lunch and her evening meds.
entries.outcome: Lola Cora grumbled but was fine.

entries.what: Meant to draft questions for tomorrow's meeting with Mr. Kim but spent the night on Ramón's old desktop recoloring her college list spreadsheet instead.
entries.outcome: Spreadsheet looks great, questions still unwritten.

entries.what: Fell asleep close to 1 a.m. with the alarm set for 6:50.
entries.outcome: Short sleep before a big day.

entries.what: Met Mr. Kim in the counseling office; he talked her through adding safeties, bringing the list to 12 schools including 4 UCs, Bayshore State and an in-state polytechnic.
Robotics in room C7 from 3:30 to 6, working on the drivetrain with Lucas nearby.
entries.outcome: Got her subassembly done on schedule.

entries.what: Walked home, ate dinner with the family, and told Lola Cora about the new safety schools. Grace seemed pleased about Bayshore State.
Wednesday classes, then tutored Mateo in fractions at Kessler Middle from 4 to 5 for $20.
entries.outcome: Mateo got through a full worksheet.

entries.what: Started the Mom sheet that evening, asking for financial aid info without the usual talk-to-your-parents line. Noted her $160 savings goal for application fees and her SAT fee waiver status.
entries.outcome: First rough version of the cost comparison made.

entries.what: Heard from Nadia about the city council candidate forum at the community center tonight, but skipped it for homework.
entries.outcome: Stayed home and finished AP Lang reading.

entries.what: Asked Ms. Lugo and her physics teacher Mr. Okafor to be her recommenders.
Thursday robotics in room C7, 3:30 to 6.
Did two SAT practice sections with a kitchen timer at night, then worked on the essay.
Friday at school; Nadia mentioned the homecoming plans and Isabel said she is skipping the dance and will go to the game with her for yearbook photos.
Got a ride home from Nadia in her brother's beige sedan and picked up jasmine milk tea at Cloud Nine first.
Quiet evening at home listening to film scores while working on essay edits.
Saturday SAT prep with Harper at the library from 10 to 12.
entries.outcome: Timed sections done; Harper said she is on track.

entries.what: Photographed egrets at Ulloa Salt Marsh Park in the afternoon and updated her tally notebook.
entries.outcome: Added a few new birds to the tally.

entries.what: Practiced driving in the Ruel Road lots with Ramón on his off day.
Sunday morning Grace graded papers after Tagalog Mass with Lola Cora while Isabel stayed home to write.
Mocked Grace's lab-safety jokes to Nadia, then asked for a chemistry example for her essay that Grace would find accurate.
entries.outcome: Found an example about water filtration chemistry.

entries.what: Lola Cora's sinigang for Sunday dinner; Isabel pretended not to care and had two bowls.
